subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for Acme Bank
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@acmebank.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmebank.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for Acme Bank

Hi Oliver / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed next-step POC plan so we can align on success criteria and timelines.

Call highlights:
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood for large-scale, low-latency customer support summarization and routing (estimated 2k reqs/min peak).
- Key constraints: data residency in us-east, SOC 2 evidence required, ability to pin model versions for predictable latency.
- Initial scope: 2 representative workflows (live chat summarization + ticket triage) with 1 week perf/eval run.

Proposed POC (attached: Acme_POCTest_plan_v1.pdf):
- Duration: 4 weeks (1 week setup + 2 weeks evaluation + 1 week wrap-up).
- Success criteria (pass/fail):
  1) 95th p90 latency < 300ms for 512-token bursts under expected load (measured at Redwood endpoint).
  2) Average summary quality score >= 4.0 on Acme labeling rubric (we'll provide rubric).
  3) No PII leakage in outputs during 2-week test (automated checks + sample review).
- Redwood deliverables: sandbox endpoints, sample dataset ingestion guide, monitoring dashboard, and weekly check-ins.
- Acme deliverables: sample data subset (anonymized), evaluation rubric, one technical owner for onboarding, procurement contact for statement of work.

Next steps we propose:
1) Camila to share POC plan + demo recording (attached).
2) Oliver / Priya to confirm success criteria and nominate technical owner.
3) Schedule kickoff for week of Mar 28th if procurement timeline allows.

Please see the attached POC plan and the demo recording link. Happy to adjust timelines — calling out procurement may need additional week.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for Acme Bank

Camila —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifying questions from our side before we lock dates:
1) For the latency criterion, can Redwood provide a short test harness we can run from our environment to validate 95th percentile?
2) On data residency: we need logs and any stored artifacts to remain in our AWS account / us-east region. Is a private deployment required or can the sandbox meet that requirement?
3) On evaluation rubric: can you include a sample template we can use to score summaries?

Success criteria looks good overall. We'll nominate a technical owner — likely Priya — and I will loop procurement (procurement@acmebank.com) to begin SOW review.

Can we tentatively schedule kickoff for Mar 29th? Procurement may push it a week.

Thanks,
Oliver
Head of Digital Channels | Acme Bank

Oliver — great questions. Answers inline and a couple of adjustments to the plan.

1) Test harness: yes — we can provide a simple JMeter script + a small client that runs from your environment to hit our sandbox and capture p95/p99. We'll include instructions in the plan.

2) Data residency / storage: the sandbox will be in our hosted env by default; for logs/artifacts you can choose one of two options:
   a) Redwood-hosted sandbox in us-east with strict access controls and dedicated tenancy (we can sign DPA + data processing addendum).
   b) Private deployment (VPC peering) into your AWS account — this is recommended if you require logs and artifacts to stay in your account. Private will add ~2 weeks to setup.

3) Evaluation rubric: attached a sample rubric section in Acme_POCTest_plan_v1.pdf (pages 3-4). It includes scoring for accuracy, faithfulness, and actionability.

Updated timeline options:
- Option A (faster): Hosted sandbox — Kickoff Mar 29; total 4 weeks; results mid-April.
- Option B (private): Kickoff Apr 12; adds 2 weeks for private setup; results end of April.

Ownership: Priya as technical owner + procurement contact copied. Dylan at Redwood will be technical lead for onboarding; Marissa will run weekly exec syncs.

I've uploaded the demo recording to a shared drive (link below) and reattached the POC plan. If procurement needs a formal SOW I can push a draft to them by end of day tomorrow.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d5E
